description: Place a watermark image, logo PNG, or branding graphic over a video with customizable position, padding, scaling, and opacity.

hardwareAcceleration.description: Use hardware-accelerated video encoding when available. Default: true.

opacity.description: Overlay opacity from 0.05 (subtle watermark) to 1.0 (fully opaque). Default: 1.0.

outputPath.description: Destination path for the output video (.mp4 or .mov).

overlayPath.description: Path to the watermark, logo, or overlay image (.png, .jpg, or .webp).

padding.description: Margin padding in pixels from the edge. Default: 20.

position.description: Corner or screen placement for the overlay. Default: 'bottom_right'.

scaleWidth.description: Optional width in pixels to scale the overlay, keeping its original aspect ratio (e.g. 150).

videoPath.description: Path to the base video file.

name: add_overlay
